newsitem.title: USA: FAA may act on licenses of Asiana pilots - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: FAA may act on licenses of Asiana pilots - WSJ.

text.p: In a test of the Federal Aviation Administration's authority to police the training of foreign pilots, the agency has threatened to suspend the commercial licenses of 26 pilots working for South Korea's Asiana Airlines, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday.

The agency has given the Asiana pilots until the end of the year to make arrangements for a second round of flight tests in the U.S., or it will take steps to suspend their certificates, the paper said.

The dispute, closing in on a public climax after months of private manoeuvrings by the airline's lawyers, is believed to be the first time the FAA has challenged so many pilots holding commercial transport certificates at a single overseas carrier, the paper added.
